narr: Scattered thunderstorms developed along and east of a stationary front draped across central Virginia and produced heavy rain and flash flooding on June 23.
ev: Virginia Highway 324 was closed due to standing water.
Flooding was reported around the University of Richmond. College Road was closed due to standing water.
A COOP Observer measured 2.82 inches of rain with streets and yards flooded.
Standing water was reported on Farnham Circle.
